requirement.description: The _ModuleBuilderDomainSet class lacks proper iteration support, causing TypeError when trying to iterate over it during domain lookup in test_domain_lookup.
requirement.contract: The _ModuleBuilderDomainSet class must implement __iter__ method to allow iteration over its contained domains, enabling proper domain resolution during fragment preparation.

requirement.description: Simulator test cases fail with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'tick', 'set', 'posedge', 'changed', or 'delay' due to missing or improperly initialized simulator objects.
requirement.contract: All simulator objects (tick, set, posedge, changed, delay) must be properly initialized and accessible to prevent AttributeError exceptions in test cases like test_tick_repeat_until, test_broken_other_trigger, test_sample, etc.

requirement.description: RTLIL memory conversion fails in test_async_read and test_sync_read due to missing or incorrect handling of memory port operations and initialization.
requirement.contract: The RTLIL backend must correctly convert memory read/write ports and their associated initialization data to proper RTLIL cells, ensuring memory operations are correctly represented in the generated RTLIL output.
